note: Authored holds, the way a game animator keeps grip poses: each on a mark (a socket) of the gun, in the gun's own axes (forward = the bore, up, left). The firing grip comes from the owner's approved experiment (captured/<gun>_r_grip.json); its fingers' rules are here.

index.why: straight along line B, off the trigger (the experiment: 0.01 deg)

middle.why: wraps the front strap until it touches

ring.why: wraps the front strap until it touches

pinky.why: wraps the front strap until it touches

thumb.why: closes onto the frame's other side until it touches

l:support:palm.source: authored (fakepose 0.1, 2026-10-23): the firing grip mirrored across the gun's middle plane, 1.5 cm forward and 1.5 cm down, set down onto the firing fingers (push out): the support palm over the firing fingers on the grip's open side (FM 3-23.35 2-2), the way games make a support grip from the firing one

l:mag_grab.source: authored (fakepose 0.1, 2026-10-23): the magazine taken from below, the palm under its base, the fingers wrapping its front

l:magazine.source: authored (fakepose 0.1, 2026-10-23): the magazine taken from below, the palm under its base, the fingers wrapping its front

index.why: the index straight along the magazine's front

l:slide_rear.source: authored (fakepose 0.1, 2026-10-23): the overhand rack, the palm down on the slide's rear, the fingers across its right side, the thumb on its left

l:slide_front.source: authored (fakepose 0.1, 2026-10-24): the press check from the side, the support hand on the slide's left, thumb and index pinching its front
